name: ht16k33
title: Holtek HT16K33 LED matrix driver
notes: It keeps 16x8 LEDs in its RAM and scans them itself, with a key scan beside. A0 to A2 choose its address, 0x70 when they are open.
On 5 V a high level on SDA and SCL starts at 0.7 VDD, 3.5 V, so a chip of 3.3 V falls short.

datasheet.source: Holtek HT16K33A datasheet Rev. 1.00 of May 11, 2022, the copy of akizukidenshi.com (HT16K33A.pdf, sha256 5c1312f2...): VDD 4.5 to 5.5 V, VIH of SDA and SCL 0.7 VDD, fSCL to 400 kHz, the address 1110 A2 A1 A0 with A2 to A0 at 0 when they float
